verdict.rationale: Whether a customer data platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows mParticle's source being published or licensed openly. The 'Client SDKs' entry gives no license or repository details. The downloadable OpenAPI spec for the Events API is an API description, not product source, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
